title: bad or good enough graphics?
author: Golgorz
selftext: Building my 3D world for mobile(need to manage tris and draw calls), Claude built an editor tool for me to build the biomes (select pencils to place trees, flowers, textures, rocks etc, base terrain is built with a seed and noises, some sort of what  minecraft does but in a simple way, what do you think? is it bad? fair enough? this is my 4th iteration on the open world (started with a plain 2D image) UI is still under dev, was first a portrait mode

comments.author: i_rate_slop
comments.body:
This could pass if your gameplay is good. It doesn’t look amazing, but you can out-charm mediocre graphics with fun gameplay.

You could make the UI nicer though. It’s a little plain.

replies.author: barkywoodson
replies.body: Agree. Fun gameplay matters more. Get the feel right and then circle back to polish the look.

comments.author: Felfedezni
comments.body: There are people making 8bit and ps1 looking games.  Somehow there's an audience for them. So it is more about the aesthetic than the graphics.

comments.author: toiletman74
comments.body: Are you trying to sell the game?

comments.author: FancyName_132
comments.body: The horse sticks out with its texture is much more detailed than the rest, it looks like you glued a picture of a horse in the middle of a PS2 game. The grass is on the opposite side of the spectrum, almost too simple looking

comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body:
Why settle for good enough? Why not go there extra mile and make it look awesome? 
And yes you can!
